data.name: Moazzem
data.gender_notes: Moazzem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who calls, invites or warns, especially about Islam. The name Moazzem carries the meaning “Warner” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moazzem usually hope their child will grow to embody warner and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To call to the right path of Allah.
data.etymology: Moazzem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warner.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moazzem total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: معظم
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم المعظم يعني العظيم جدا أو المكرم بشدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم معظّم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عظم' والذي يعني العظمة أو الكرامة. يستخدم الاسم ليعبر عن الرفعة و العلو في الشأن و المكانة. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، مما يعطيه قدسية و مكانة عالية في اللغة و الثقافة العربية الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: معظم
in_urdu.meaning: معظم نام کا مطلب بہت عظیم یا انتہائی مکرام والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: معظم نام عربی جڑ 'عظم' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب عظمت یا کرامت ہے۔ یہ نام کسی کی رفعت، علو شان اور مقام کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں آیا ہے، جو اسے لسانی اور ثقافتی لحاظ سے اہم بناتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشروں میں بھی اس نام کی روایات اور استعمال پائے جاتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मोअज़्ज़म
in_hindi.meaning: मोअज़्ज़म नाम का अर्थ बहुत महान या अत्यधिक पूजनीय
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोअज़्ज़म नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'अज़म' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ महानता या गरिमा है। यह नाम किसी की उच्चता, प्रतिष्ठा और पदवी को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में मिलता है, जो इसे भाषाई और सांस्कृतिक दृष्टि से महत्वपूर्ण बनाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इस नाम की परंपराएं और उपयोग पाए जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: معظم
in_pashto.meaning: د معظم نوم معنی ډیر لوی یا ډیر ویاړلی
in_pashto.long_meaning: معظم نوم د عربي ريښې 'عظم' څخه اخستل شوی دی چې معنی يې عظمت يا کرامت دی. دا نوم د کوم چا د لوړوالي، عزت او مقام ښودنه کوي. په اسلامي دود کې دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې راغلی دی، چې دا لفظي او کلتوري لحاظه مهم کوي. په افغان او پښتون دودونو کې ددې نوم کارول او روايات شته دي.

in_english.name: Moazzem
in_english.meaning: The name Moazzem means extremely great or highly honored
in_english.long_meaning: The name Moazzem is derived from the Arabic root 'azama', which means to be great or to honor. This name signifies greatness, high esteem, and nobility. It is mentioned in the Quran, which adds to its sanctity and high status in Arabic language and Islamic culture. The name reflects elevated status and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition.

This is a title that has been given to various individuals throughout history who have dedicated their lives to spreading the message of Islam. From preachers and teachers to community leaders and imams, Moazzem represents a commitment to faith, a deep sense of responsibility towards the Muslim community, and an unwavering courage in sharing the truth of Islam with others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Moazzem holds a profound spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition, as it signifies a call or invitation to a deeper connection with God. This can be seen as a reminder of the importance of sharing knowledge and wisdom with others, as well as the responsibility to guide and inspire those around us on the path to spiritual growth. Moazzem also represents the idea of being a messenger or servant of God, constantly striving to uphold the values and teachings of Islam in both words and actions. Ultimately, the name Moazzem serves as a powerful reminder of the essential role that each Muslim plays in the greater spiritual community, and the importance of remaining steadfast and committed to the pursuit of knowledge and piety.

historical_references.reference: Moazzem was a prominent Sufi scholar and poet during the 13th century in Persia. He was the founder of the Saburiyya order of Sufism, which emphasized the importance of spiritual intoxication and the ecstatic union with God.
historical_references.context: Sufi scholar and founder of Saburiyya order of Sufism, Persia

historical_references.reference: Moazzem al-Din Alp Arslan was a Seljuk Sultan who ruled Anatolia from 1190 to 1211. He was known for his military conquests and the expansion of the Seljuk Empire in Anatolia. The name Moazzem means 'illuminating' in Arabic, reflecting his role as a source of enlightenment and guidance for his people.
historical_references.context: Seljuk Sultan and military conqueror, Anatolia
